spans.text: The petitioners who take to join Harros’ militia in the Valley of Setting Dreams are named for the city they protect - the Monument. They hold no special rank over other petitioners in the realm, but serve as protectors and sentinels who act in the name of good. Should Harros ever require warriors in an inter-planar conflict, they would stand on the front lines, hand-in-hand.

Their power structure is straightforward: one of every hundred aspiring Monumentals are chosen to lead another ninety-nine, forming a single squad known as a brotherhood. Each adopts a name they identify with, such as the red brotherhood, roaring brotherhood, witchlight brotherhood, etc., and after being established they can accept other Monumental soldiers and recruits who seek them out. At any given time there are several dozen of these brotherhoods. To this end, they form loose guild-like structures within their own ranks.

“No standing army among the gods is mythologized quite like Harros and his monumentals. Art of them is always so gloriously rendered, depicting them with spears that twist the world apart. They say that every knight who dreams of righteousness hopes to sit among the monumentals in the afterlife.”
